## Braintree Auth

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-auth/overview): To help you understand how Braintree Auth works, we've developed a sample application for your reference.
- [Configuration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-auth/configuration/): Braintree Auth is in closed beta.

- [Server-side Connect Flow](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-auth/server-side/): [best practices guide](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/reference/general/best-practices/ruby)to learn more.

- [Webhooks](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-auth/webhooks/): Braintree Auth is in closed beta. [Contact us](https://www.braintreepayments.com/products/braintree-auth#contact) to express interest.
- [Merchant API](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-auth/merchant-api/): This is how to create a transaction using an access token: 1. Ruby

- [Testing and Go Live](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/braintree-auth/testing-go-live/): [Contact us](https://www.braintreepayments.com/products/braintree-auth#contact)to express interest.
